card.name: REMS acronym letters, MS ending
card.fires_on: The final piece "MS" (or "EMS") completing the acronym REMS, as in Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS), including in REMS phone numbers and web addresses. Also fires on a name-internal piece like "ers" in a personal name.

modes.label: REMS acronym
modes.description: The "MS" ending after "RE" in the parenthesized acronym for Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy.

modes.label: Other acronym or name piece
modes.description: A piece inside another acronym or a proper name, such as LEMS or a surname.
modes.example: Recommended Oral Dosage for the Treatment of L<<EMS>> in Adults and Pediatric Patients 6 Years

card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of the acronym REMS, the risk-management program name found in drug labels.
